title: Request headers
description: Headers a client sends (E18): CampusLife-Contract on every request, CampusLife-Epoch on the operations the OpenAPI document gives it (D24). Open: other headers pass; Authorization is described with the OpenAPI document.

CampusLife-Contract.description: The client's contract version as a decimal integer, the same number space as Hub contract_version.

CampusLife-Epoch.description: The Hub epoch the client's cache, cursor and kept Mutations belong to: the epoch of its first GET /v1/hub, changed only when it handles a 409 epoch_changed (D24). A Hub whose epoch differs answers 409 epoch_changed before it reads the body.
